_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY — W21 prepare-only workstream. No deployment is performed from this repository. Apply this egg by importing it into the Pterodactyl panel manually; resource caps (RAM/CPU) are enforced by the panel server allocation plus deploy/RESOURCE-LIMITS.md, not by this file. Spec: MASTER-SPECIFICATION.md §§35, 63.
author: enthusia-ai-w21
description: Template egg for the Enthusia AI split: agent, Discord bot, local inference (llama.cpp), indexer, and vector store. Each role is one Pterodactyl server on this egg; AI_SERVICE selects the role. PREPARE ONLY — not deployed.
name: Enthusia AI (TEMPLATE)

scripts.install:
#!/bin/ash
# TEMPLATE install script — intentionally a no-op.
# The real install pins the service artifact built by CI (see deploy/RUNBOOK.md).
echo 'Enthusia AI egg: nothing to install at template import time.'

variables.description: Which Enthusia AI role this server runs: agent, discord, inference, indexer. One role per Pterodactyl server (§35.1).
variables.name: AI Service Role

variables.description: Hard cap for the inference model resident memory, in GB. Initial envelope 24-32 GB per spec §63. Mirrors MODEL_RAM_MAX_GB in resource-limits.env.
variables.name: Model RAM Cap (GB)

variables.description: llama.cpp thread count. Explicitly bounded so inference cannot saturate all cores (§35.2).
variables.name: Inference Threads

variables.description: Indexer worker concurrency. Low-priority background work (§63).
variables.name: Indexer Threads

variables.description: Optional taskset CPU list for the inference process, e.g. '8-15'. Empty = no pinning. Documented in deploy/RESOURCE-LIMITS.md.
variables.name: CPU Pinning

variables.description: Metrics port for Enthusia Node services. Raw llama.cpp exposes /metrics on HEALTH_PORT when --metrics is enabled.
variables.name: Metrics Port

variables.description: HTTP/health port. Raw llama.cpp serves /health, /metrics, and /v1/* on this same port.
variables.name: Health Port

variables.description: llama.cpp bind host. Default loopback prevents accidental public exposure. Set only to a private/internal address when cross-container access is required.
variables.name: Inference Bind Host

variables.description: Service API key required by the local inference runtime. SECRET — injected in the panel, then passed to llama.cpp through LLAMA_API_KEY (not command-line argv).
variables.name: Inference API Key

variables.description: Discord bot token. SECRET — injected in the panel, never committed (§34.1).
variables.name: Discord Bot Token

variables.description: OpenAI API key for strong-model escalation. SECRET — injected in the panel, never committed (§34.1).
variables.name: OpenAI API Key

variables.description: Postgres connection string for durable metadata. SECRET — injected in the panel, never committed (§34.1).
variables.name: Database URL
